name: Meiji Shipping Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Meiji Shipping Group Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the maritime business in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Ocean Shipping Business, Hotel-Related Business, and Real Estate Rental Business. It owns crude and product oil, methanol, and chemical tankers, as well as LNG, LPG, car, container, chip, and bulk carriers that are operated under time charter parties with shipping companies.
